comment: Replicated within P-0001's stated domain (lone species A, one particle). Round 2 (001-003): x=10 and y=0 wall reflections at speed 1.0 fit the elastic model at rms 0.046-0.055 per coordinate; wall-stop and wrap-around rejected. Round 3 edge tests against P-0001 model.py: 011 (speed about 0.8, 100 time units, census): rms 0.049/0.051, 0 census events. 012 (start (1,8), velocity (3.6,-2.1), speed about 4.2, 100 time units, many reflections): rms 0.050/0.050. 013 (exact corner hit at (10,10) at t=2/3, velocity (3,3)): rms 0.051/0.050. 014 (speed about 7.8, 30 time units, multiple reflections): rms 0.049/0.051. All residuals have mean below 0.004 and max |res| below 0.22. This extends the verdict from the x=10 and y=0 walls at speed 1.0 to corners, speeds up to 7.8, and durations to 100. Not tested by me: the x=0 and y=10 walls on their own, and species other than A (lab-b's own B/C runs are not in this review). Verdict covers the claim as written (species A, one particle).
